about: Shared names and choice lines (docs/SPEC.md §14.10). Run by backend/tests/test_mentions.py and frontend/src/matcher.test.ts, so the server and the browser agree. Each expected hit is [matched, kind, entry].

cases.about: a bare shared first name is ambiguous: one hit per claimant
a choice line settles it from there on, endings included; the line itself names nobody
cases.text:
%% Isolde: Isolde Marr
Isolde left. Isolde's lamp.

cases.about: before the first line it is ambiguous; each line holds to the next; ? unsettles it
cases.text:
Isolde came.
%% Isolde: Marr
Isolde left.
  %% Isolde: senn
Isolde stayed.
%% Isolde: ?
Isolde slept.

cases.about: several chosen: a mention of each
cases.text:
%% Isolde: Marr, Isolde Senn
Isolde sang.

cases.about: a line that singles out nobody does nothing
cases.text:
%% Isolde: Mar
Isolde sang.
%% Isolde: Isolde
Isolde sang.

cases.about: a margin note that is not about a shared name is an ordinary note
cases.text:
%% Todo: Marr
%% Varren: Hale
Isolde sang. Varren too.

cases.about: an other name given to two entries is shared the same way, with either article
cases.text:
The Warden spoke.
%% the Warden: Ilse Brand
the Warden left. The Warden's keys.

cases.about: an entry's own name wins over another's first name
claimants of different kinds share too
cases.text:
the Quay
%% the Quay: Old Harbour
the Quay

cases.about: a choice for one shared name leaves another alone
cases.text:
%% Isolde: Marr
The Warden and Isolde.

cases.about: a first name only one character has is theirs
an invalid line leaves the choice before it in force
cases.text:
%% Isolde: Senn
Isolde.
%% Isolde: Nobody
Isolde.

cases.about: in the Journal choice lines are read, and other %% lines are ordinary text
cases.text:
%% Isolde: Marr
Isolde sang.
%% about Varren Hale

cases.about: outside chapters and the Journal, choice lines are not read
